testCase.name: [local] S28 Wrong browser clock: a task ticked done is stamped and shown on server time, and the date header shows the server's day

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S28 Wrong browser clock: a task ticked done is stamped and shown on server time, and the date header shows the server's day

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • G2 UAT 3.8: the stored doneAt, the day/visit shown on a closed task and the date header of the screen and of Copy Text follow server time, not the device clock (UAT 3.8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; one open task on a Hospital patient and one on a Nursing Home resident on Today's Visits; the server's now and today from time:now

When In a Playwright context with context.clock.setSystemTime(serverNow + 24 h) — and a second run with serverNow − 24 h, and one with timezoneId 'Pacific/Kiritimati' for the header — tick the task done on /rounding/tasks and on /snf/tasks; read the task's doneAt through backend.query (rounding:list / snf:list); …

Then doneAt is within 5 minutes of server time in every run; the header date equals the server's today; after the lifecycle run the completed task is still listed (a −24 h stamp would clear it at once, a +24 h stamp would keep it about 40 h)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8 (G2): every time-based rule uses the server clock. Predicted Fail on main: TasksOverlay.tsx line 110 stamps doneAt with new Date() and line 241 prints the header date with new Date(). S23 keeps the real-phone version

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92585 ready for pr

With the device clock a day behind, a task the physician just ticked is stamped as yesterday, disappears from the list the next time it opens, and the task screen is dated yesterday; a day ahead, done times are stamped tomorrow.

Evidence: newspec-b: at −24 h doneAt is −1440 min and the header reads 'Tue, Oct 13' (server day Wed Oct 14); at +24 h doneAt is +1440 min, and the saved session was refused first. Main stamps doneAt and the header with the device's new Date() (UAT 3.8 / TC-07 G2). Predicted in the TC-07 risks only. PR #106's TasksOverlay uses clockNow() (server-offset clock), so it is probably fixed there; recheck after the merge.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S28

Wrong browser clock: a task ticked done is stamped and shown on server time, and the date header shows the server's day

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr)

New local lane newspec-b: status failed in newspec-b/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec, fresh account, three runs: context clock serverNow+24 h, serverNow−24 h, and timezoneId Pacific/Kiritimati; tick the task on /rounding/tasks and /snf/tasks; read doneAt via rounding:list / snf:list; read the screen's date header; reopen lists so the lifecycle runs; open the task view again. — page.clock / timezoneId in our own spec (the agent runner cannot, the scripted spec can).

Detail:

Device −24 h: doneAt stored 24 h in the past (−1440 min vs server), header 'Tue, Oct 13' (server day Wed Oct 14), and on reopening the list the completed task is gone from the chart. Device +24 h: saved session refused; after signing in again doneAt +1440 min, header 'Thu, Oct 15'. Kiritimati, correct clock: doneAt within 0.05 min, header recorded (TC-11 Q4). Both modes alike.

Product issue: With a phone clock a day behind, a task the physician just ticked disappears from the list the next time it opens, and the screen is dated yesterday; a day ahead, done times are stamped tomorrow. Breaks UAT 3.8 / TC-07 G2 (stamps and dates follow server time). TasksOverlay stamps doneAt and prints the header with the device's new Date().

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: our own planned Playwright spec (runnerGaps 9, not written yet) is local-stack only: a fresh account plus backend.mutation / backend.query need the admin key, which dev does not have, so the dev run leaves it to the local run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
